_doc: Exceptions for ui/tools/i18n_check.mjs (glossary, truncation). Each entry: {check, reason, and any of id / lang / term_id / selector / page to narrow it}; an entry without a non-empty reason is ignored. zh_CN is never allowed here.

entries.reason: P5 en_US (10-20): source-type label in a 132px select (91px for the value) and the type chip; Subscription URL (106px) was clipped, so the label reads Subscription. F-01 (10-27) removed the hint below the field (settings.bastion.src.sub.hint), so the full term subscription URL is no longer shown; the short label still names the source type.

P5 pt_BR (10-20): same as en_US. Source-type label in a 132px select (91px for the value) and the type chip; URL da assinatura (110px) was clipped by 19px (render run p5b-20261020, settings_i18n_page, both sizes), so the label reads Assinatura (still the glossary's role_sentinel word). F-01 (10-27) removed the hint below the field (settings.bastion.src.sub.hint), so the full term URL da assinatura is no longer shown; the short label still names the source type.

P5 de_DE (10-20): same as en_US. F-01 (10-27) removed the hint below the field (settings.bastion.src.sub.hint), so the full term Abonnement-URL is no longer shown; the short label still names the source type.

P5 ja_JP (10-20): same as en_US. Source-type label in a 132px select (91px for the value) and the type chip; サブスクリプション URL (~113px) overflowed the value by 25px (render run p5b-20261020, settings_i18n_page, both sizes), so the label reads サブスク URL (~68px; サブスク is the glossary's own ja form of role_sentinel and the common abbreviation). F-01 (10-27) removed the hint below the field (settings.bastion.src.sub.hint), so the full term サブスクリプション URL is no longer shown; the short label still names the source type.

P5 es_ES (10-20): same as en_US. Source-type label in a 132px select (91px for the value) and the type chip; URL de suscripción (118px) overflowed the value by 27px (render run p5b-20261020, settings_i18n_page, both sizes), so the label reads Suscripción (~70px; still the glossary's role_sentinel word suscripci). F-01 (10-27) removed the hint below the field (settings.bastion.src.sub.hint), so the full term URL de suscripción is no longer shown; the short label still names the source type.

P5 fr_FR (10-20): same as en_US. F-01 (10-27) removed the hint below the field (settings.bastion.src.sub.hint), so the full term URL d’abonnement is no longer shown; the short label still names the source type.

P5 en_US (10-21, Claude D5 review): here 订阅 is the verb (subscribe to the ntfy / Pushover topic on a phone), not the Sentinel role noun; the glossary note anticipates this case. "Subscribe on your phone (optional)" says what the section does; the noun form "Phone subscription" read as a plan or contract.
